modelIdFormatNote: Values here are SHORT IDs (human-readable). At spawn time, the coordinator resolves each to its full prefixed form via the HARD GATE in .squad/templates/model-selection-reference.md ('Resolving valid model IDs') — run the __discover__ probe before the first spawn of each session. If a spawn fails with 'model provider not found' or 'Model not available', you skipped the gate: run __discover__, use the prefixed form, retry. Do NOT edit this file to add prefixes — config stays short; resolution happens at spawn and is cached in coordinator session memory only. PLACEMENT FOOTGUN: on create_session, model goes INSIDE kickoff (kickoff.model), NOT at the top level — a top-level model is silently ignored and the session inherits the coordinator default. See .squad/templates/model-selection-reference.md 'Passing the model to spawns' for both tool shapes.
